principle: Runner/request timeouts are the TEST CLIENT's budget, never a system contract. Only source/config-declared deadlines count for contract-violation judgment (A2 audit). 'unknown' means source not checked.

OB-checkout->payment.evidence: online-boutique/src/checkoutservice/main.go:369 chargeCard -> PaymentService.Charge(ctx) no WithTimeout/WithDeadline; card KB-OB-CHECKOUT-PAYMENT-DELAY-001 confirms
OB-checkout->payment.note: 10s hang is client budget exhaustion, NOT system contract violation; the weakness is the ABSENCE of a system timeout

OB-checkout->cart.note: client process error at ~12s (connect+read); system has no cart timeout
